comparison.objective: Unplug a USB-C cable and stow a spot welder in its holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual device stabilization, tight plug extraction, placement and reorientation.
comparison.success_condition: Plug removed by its body and laid down; welder seated upright; arms returned; no dropped parts.
comparison.reason: Tight connector extraction is meaningfully different from engaging a hex fastener and iteratively tuning and locking a damper.
